title: 4 legged animal (dog) controllable walk animation is possible (this result took me at least 40-50+ iterations but I'm very happy with the result) (Gemini 3.8 Flash)
author: LionLikeMan

comments.author: LionLikeMan
comments.body: The programming language of choice was Babylon.js

replies.author: LionLikeMan
replies.body: Right? Gemini 3.8 Flash did a great job, I really feel that I have a super smart and capable programming person with me that is super rich with knowledge and general expertise, it's just fun developing stuff with it and seeing great results.

replies.author: fluxtah
replies.body: Yeh I'm surprised because Goog had a hard time catching up. Sadly I'm to much of a gpt fanboy to even try though cool you found value in it! 🙏

replies.author: LionLikeMan
replies.body: It's really good now, you should give it a try on aistudio of google site (don't forget to select Gemini 3.8 Flash on the right side of options)

replies.author: LionLikeMan
replies.body: Yes :) it's great what Gemini 3.8 Flash can achieve with enough patience and development cycles.

comments.author: AlgaeNo3373
comments.body:
https://preview.redd.it/kcm4111fa1sh1.png?width=560&format=png&auto=webp&s=783825da7b247002ac17f1e650bba9025ec5349a

Looks really good (and trippy haha). Only thing I'd suggest (as non-expert! just based on vibes) is the sprint being less "hoppy" and more like back legs going through. Look around 1:22 of vid for reference. 

Super cool though. The slower movements/micro movements and stuff are really convincing even for a doggo made of wireframes.

replies.author: LionLikeMan
replies.body: You are correct, the galloping indeed requires more work, it's not too bad as a start but still not quite there yet, I will try to add the type of motion pose into the galloping using your reference, thanks for the heads up.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body:
Glad it's helpful \^\^

Is this a game where we are a doggo? That would be v fun to play.

replies.author: LionLikeMan
replies.body: Not really, it is kinda fun to control the dog, I can release the demo's code if you want me to, basically I built some mini cool world with lots of details like mountains, ships, birds and grass and sea and so on and then I wanted to see if its possible to also add walking animals to inhabit that planet it built for me and so I figured to my surprise it indeed can but now it seems more like I might want to try and do muscle simulation with skin simulation on top of it but I'm not sure if that's too much to handle for Gemini 3.8 Flash or if that's actually something he can as well figure out and do somehow, who knows, it feels to me that Gemini might pull off even that.

replies.author: AlgaeNo3373
replies.body: Sure! If you chuck it up in a repo I can fw it, see what Astra or Opus 5.5 do etc and share something back if you like \^\^

comments.author: Livid_Shallot5701
comments.body:
with iterations you mean: one agent tries to write an animation, another specialized in QA checks if its any good and sends first agent back to the drawingboard with feedback what looks bad? 

or how do you guys do iterations? ore human iterations of the same thing "ok try this. ok looks bad, change this. ok now this looks goofy, try this. ok buggy go back now try this ..."

?

replies.author: LionLikeMan
replies.body: By iterations I just mean me prompting it back and fourth telling it what is still wrong and what to fix and improve upon.
